title: Gaussian upper bounds for averaged heat semigroups on graphs
summary: Characterizations of pointwise Gaussian upper bounds on graphs with possibly unbounded geometry in terms of localized functional inequalities contain errors depending on the vertex degree. We introduce a new space-time averaged form of the heat semigroup in terms of time-averaged $\ell^{q/(q-1)}-\ell^q$-estimates and obtain Gaussian upper bounds from large-scale Faber-Krahn inequalities which avoid such errors.
